title: Identify confounding before a bulk RNA sequencing comparison
prompt: For a bulk RNA-seq study, every treated sample was sequenced in batch A and every control in batch B. A collaborator asks you to call treatment-specific genes from a normalized expression table. What needs to be resolved before making that claim? Do not edit files.
rubric: The response identifies complete confounding of treatment and batch and does not claim treatment-specific effects are identifiable from this design alone.
It distinguishes normalized expression values from the count representation required by the selected differential-expression method.
It asks for suitable design or additional data and reports limitations rather than inventing a statistical correction.
acceptance: The response identifies the confounding and the input representation limitation before drawing a treatment-specific conclusion.
